purpose: docs/37 P3 (3-1 value-type signal, 3-2 multi-intent split): pre-selection recall measured offline on a-commerce design tasks (required tools offered by ToolSession.auto before the first model request); GitHub fixed offline queries as a regression guard. Held-out tasks were not used.
catalog: a-commerce acom tools (253) converted with ToolCatalogImporter; max_tool_bytes 16000

variants.name: instance signal (word before an id/number boosts identity/input matches)
variants.note: get_order for 'order 27184' rank 79 -> 30; no recall change

clause split: whole top 8 + 2 per clause
clause split: whole top 6 + 1 per clause
declared relations (catalog consumes/produces): each of the top 3 hits pulls in the best-ranked producer and consumer that matched
relations, top 1 hit, producers and consumers

finding: Long conversational questions match many filler and generic words across 253 tools; coverage-first ranking then favors broad weak matches. Changing the word list reshuffles other tasks. Under the 16 KB schema budget the host keeps about 8 a-commerce functions whatever the preselect size. The model's own searches with short keywords recover part of the gap (see run results). The a-commerce agent's own tool search expands hits by declared consumes/produces slots; in a2api's ranking the top hits for these questions are often not the needed tools, so their neighbors displaced better candidates.
